div.head: Cn 1018 2.2
div.ab: Ðonne is swiðe rihtlic. þæt godes ciricgrið. binnon wágum. 7 cristenes cynges handgrið. stande efen unwæmme.
Ðonne is swiðe rihtlic, þæt Godes ciricgrið binnon wagum and Cristenes cynges handgrið stande efenunwæmme.
It is accordingly very proper that God's protection of the church within its walls, and the handgiven protection of a Christian king, should stand equally inviolate.
Accordingly, it is most proper that the sanctuary within the walls of God’s church and the protection received from a Christian king’s hand remain equally inviolate.
